command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "48d20ed7e17107a3d1378a394b12b5382ae58a49" ]
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
ROOT=managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee
printf '%s\n' '=== ezbee command headers ==='
find "$ROOT" -type f -maxdepth 4 -print | sort | grep -Ei '(zcl|command|on.?off|level)' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== ezbee command symbols ==='
grep -RniE -C 5 'on.?off|level.?control|move.?to.?level|toggle|command.*req|cmd.*req' "$ROOT" | sed -n '1,800p' || true
